title: Elizondo points AARO to a safe drawer that turns out empty

tellings.quote: but I know there was an episode uh like this with Lou Alzando where he told them of a particular location, an office, a safe a safe drawer, and the uh only to be told that when uh when they opened it up, there was nothing there.

plain: A former US Senate staffer named Kirk McConnell, on Jesse Michels's podcast, tells of an episode in the 2020s involving AARO, the Pentagon office set up to investigate UFO reports, and Lou Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who speaks publicly about UFOs. According to McConnell, Elizondo told AARO about a specific office and a specific safe drawer where material could be found, but when they opened it, it was empty. He tells it as an example of records that someone points to and that then turn out to be missing.
